description: Java class representing a Device entity in the Thingsboard platform, including properties like tenant, customer, device profile, firmware, software, and device data, with serialization/deserialization logic and annotations for schema and validation.

classes.name: Device
classes.description: Represents a device with properties such as tenant, customer, profile, firmware, software, and device data, including methods for serialization, updating, and schema annotations.

methods.name: Device
methods.description: Constructor initializing Device with an ID.

methods.name: updateDevice
methods.description: Updates current Device instance with data from another Device object.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the DeviceId, with schema description for API.

methods.description: Returns the TenantId associated with the device.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Returns the CustomerId associated with the device.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the CustomerId for the device.

methods.name: getOwnerId
methods.description: Returns the owner EntityId, either customer or tenant.
